{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm no other values in status
assert set(df['status'].unique()) == {'completed', 'refunded'}, "Unexpected values in 'status' column"

# Count completed orders
completed_count = df[df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

print(f'Completed orders: {completed_count}')"}
